candidate.answerReason: The bulb is 230 cm above the floor, and Alice can reach 196 cm while on the floor. The stool must supply the remaining 34 cm, choice B.

methods.label: Find the missing height
methods.explanation:
Express all heights in centimeters, using \(1\) meter \(=100\) centimeters. The ceiling is 240 cm high, so the bulb is
\[
240-10=230\text{ cm}
\]
above the floor. Alice is 150 cm tall and reaches another 46 cm above her head, giving a floor-standing reach of
\[
150+46=196\text{ cm}.
\]
The stool raises her reach by its own height. Since she can just reach the bulb, that height is
\[
230-196=\boxed{34\text{ cm}},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses metric length conversion and addition and subtraction of heights.

candidate.annotationRationale: The central targets are converting meters to centimeters and representing the bulb's height as Alice's reach plus the stool height. Understanding centimeters supports the conversion. The method does not require a particular written subtraction algorithm.
